// A drag force opposing velocity: force = -(LinearCoefficient * v +
// QuadraticCoefficient * |v| * v). LinearCoefficient is in newton-seconds per
// meter; QuadraticCoefficient is in newton-seconds-squared per square meter.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Drag_(physics))
type DragModel
    implements IValue, IForceModel3D
{
    LinearCoefficient: Number;
    QuadraticCoefficient: Number;
}
